title: Quest 'The Lost Fleet' says 'Speak it over the wreck at the Reeve's Pride, past the Point,' but after lighting the Farlight and exhaustively exploring every room off the Point (Hidden Shingle, the Weir, Mudflats, Low Marsh, Driftwood Reach, Fisherman's Cairn, Marram Dunes, Gull Colony, Reed Cut, Samphire Bank, Kelp Line, Widow Rocks, the Beached Longboat) I never found 'Reeve's Pride' or any action to speak the verse. 'travel to a known place' > 'the Lost Fleet' only ever routed me to the Hidden Shingle beach, which has no verse-speaking option, just flavor text about unseen oars in the fog. It may be gated behind clearing 'The Wreckers' Roost' but nothing in the quest text says so.
